In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The depiction of P2 in [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] is set during [[Secret mission to Tatooine]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates to [[1 BBY]].</ref> the prototype [[astromech droid]] '''P2''' stood within the equipment-filled garage of [[Tosche Station]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], dwarfing a nearby [[R5 series astromech droid|R5 droid]] who was repairing a generator. Soon after the ''[[Tantive IV]]'', a [[Starship|ship]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|the Rebellion]], [[Secret mission to Tatooine|battled]] the [[Galactic Empire]] in the planet's [[orbit]], the [[droid]]s bore witness to an attempted theft of parts from [[Fixer's five-engined landspeeder]] by a couple of [[Jawa]]s, a diminutive [[scavenger]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to Tatooine.<ref name="CL2016" />

P2 shared its name with the [[P2 astromech unit]], a tall droid model manufactured by the [[Industrial Automaton]] company [[Standard decade|decades]] before the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="BMF 28">{{BuildFalconCite|28|Secrets of Spaceflight}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DarklighterP2Skywalker-ANH.png|thumb|right|250px|P2 appears in a deleted scene of ''A New Hope''.]]
P2 was depicted in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2016]] reference book, [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], in a section focusing on locations from.<ref name="CL2016" /> the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Originally published in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', that section was written by [[James Luceno]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="ITW">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

P2 first appeared moving to and fro behind the windows of Tosche Station in a [[Content cut from Star Wars|deleted scene]] of ''A New Hope'', with the film's script mentioning "a robot" that "repairs some equipment in the background."<ref name="BFI 77 script">{{WebCite|url=https://www.bfi.org.uk/news-opinion/news-bfi/features/set-star-wars-episode-iv-new-hope|text=On the set of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope|author=Nathalie Morris|archivedate=20200506031354}}</ref> Although cut from the final film, the scene was included in<ref name="ANH" /> its [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray|Blu-ray]] re-release.<ref name="Blu-ray">{{SWArchive|url=movies/saga/bluraymay4/index.html|text=Bring the Complete Collection Home: ''Star Wars: The Complete Saga'' on Blu-Ray}}</ref>
